Welcome to the internal collaboration hub. This area is designated for asynchronous discussion, peer review of mathematical proofs, and experimental design planning!

## Idea Pockets

1. The package [NCTSSoS.jl](https://github.com/QuantumSOS/NCTSSoS.jl) is a newly developed method for solving sparse noncommutative polynomial optimization problems. Could it be used to solve:
    - Find optimal shadow strategy on a give non-commuting Pauli operators?
    - Find new square magic problem.
2. Given a spin glasses, is it possible to use a cooling environment to cold it to the ground state? When the system satisfied the thermalizaiton hypothesis?
